# Resources to Recover

> > A comprehensive mental health resource directory connecting individuals in Connecticut to recovery support services, crisis intervention, and specialized care for diverse communities.

Resources to Recover serves as a mental health resource hub for Fairfield County and Connecticut, offering a provider directory, specialized support for young adults and BIPOC communities, and direct access to resource specialists for crisis intervention and treatment referrals.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health Support
- Crisis Intervention
- Recovery Services
- Young Adults
- BIPOC Communities
- Resource Specialists
- ADHD
- PTSD
- OCD
- Eating Disorders
- Substance Use Treatment
- Family Support
- Community Resources
- Fairfield County
- Connecticut

## Core Services & Support

- [About Resource Specialists](https://www.rtor.org/about-resource-specialists): Explains Resources to Recover's resource specialist service and crisis support
- [Young Adult Mental Health Resources](https://www.rtor.org/recovery-support-services-for-young-adults): Young adult mental health support and recovery services in Fairfield County, CT
- [BIPOC Mental Health Resources](https://www.rtor.org/bipoc-mental-health-resources): Mental health resources for BIPOC communities addressing health equity and disparities

## Mental Health Education & Conditions

- [Failure to Launch](https://www.rtor.org/failure-to-launch): Guide to Failure to Launch syndrome in young adults with related mental health conditions

## Local Resources & Directories

- [Mental Health Services in Darien, CT](https://www.rtor.org/locations-served/darien-ct): Local mental health and addiction services directory for Darien, CT area
- [Mental Health Services in New Canaan, CT](https://www.rtor.org/locations-served/new-canaan-ct): Local mental health and addiction services directory for New Canaan, CT area

## Main Hub

- [Resources to Recover Home](https://www.rtor.org): Homepage for Resources to Recover mental health directory and support services
